grammar_scope: ASCII single-letter variables and multi-digit numeral tokens; ordinary =,+,-,comma,semicolon,colon operators.
Visible parentheses, square bracket and escaped brace fences; intentionally mixed interval [0,infinity) must not be rejected as mismatched punctuation.
Subscript/superscript operators with a single atom or braced group, including nested a_n, f_{n-1}, (a_n)_{n>=0}, and squares.
Only frac with two braced arguments; only text with exact observed content ' and ' and its spaces.
Whitelisted declarative interpretations of source \N and \st; no TeX macro expansion engine.
requirements: Retain exact raw TeX bytes/hash and inert source macros; derived MathML must not be described as canonical source MathML.
Keep source m/me owner and display kind plus every source text/term boundary; retain exact token/whitespace ledger and source annotation.
Consume every source character through explicit known grammar; reject unsupported commands/forms, do not silently strip them.
Separate normal TeX whitespace ignored for presentation from exact raw-text preservation. Preserve spaces inside text{ and }.
LTR math root/wrapper, properly isolated punctuation and subscript grouping; no source prose punctuation swallowed into formula.
Original graph SVG reuse remains separate from both math converter and inert source TikZ.
independent_qa: Do not generate expected trees by calling the converter under test.
Explicit reviewed expected descriptors for all78 unique raw formulas, bound back to105 source owners, or a genuinely independent grammar checker plus reviewed complete tree fixtures.

Detach mutations for minus/relation swaps, interval fences, variable script owners, fraction denominator, text spaces, hidden wrapper text, MathML owner interchange and raw TeX whitespace.
